== Description ==

[[Steve Harpster]] (left, black jacket, white beard, and glasses) and [[Benji Chu]] (right, Team Albany shirt, cap, and deck box) by the stream camera, with [[Mark Billings]] (background, black sunset T-shirt and ponytail) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025; distant background unlabeled.
